workflow: A container-conversion operation obtains a borrowed reference to an element and invokes user-defined conversion code on it.
The conversion code re-enters the operation’s input container and removes the element currently being converted.
Removing the element releases its last ownership reference, so the borrowed reference becomes dangling while conversion is still active.
The outer operation continues using the invalidated element reference, causing a use-after-free and process-terminating crash instead of a recoverable conversion error.
summary: Reentrant conversion invalidates the current element before use completes
decision_reason: The failure workflow materially matches reentrant user-controlled conversion invalidating a backing object or resource before the outer operation revalidates or finishes using it.
